caseName: Shuttlesworth v. Birmingham Bd. of Ed. of Jefferson Cty.
caseNameFull: SHUTTLESWORTH Et Al. v. BIRMINGHAM BOARD OF EDUCATION OF JEFFERSON COUNTY, ALABAMA
attorneys: James M. Nabrit, Jr., for appellants., Ormond Somerville, Reid B. Barnes and Jos. F. Johnston for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed upon the limited grounds on which the District Court rested its decision. 162 F. Supp. 372, 384.
